messages.content: Hey, so our apartment hunting is still dragging on. Liwei felt incredibly frustrated about it today due to the constant paperwork delays from the landlord.
Ugh, that sounds super annoying. Especially after she was so relieved to finally find a place in your budget! Is the landlord just disorganized?

Yeah, it's a mess. The guy is a bit eccentric—he actually showed up wearing a really funny hat today while dodging our questions about the contract. But I made a serious commitment to Liwei that I'll get this lease signed by Wednesday, August 13th, no matter what.

Good call setting a hard deadline. You definitely need this wrapped up, especially since you originally promised her you'd sign by yesterday! Are you both still completely sold on this specific place?

Definitely. We double-checked the route, and it's exactly 4.2 kilometers from my office, which is perfect. Liwei even noted that we should buy blue curtains for the living room once this apartment hunting nightmare is officially over.
Blue curtains will look awesome. Sounds like you're both already mentally moving in! Need me to set a reminder to bug the hat-wearing landlord tomorrow morning?
Yes, please do. I just want to get the paperwork finalized so Liwei can finally relax.
You got it. I'll remind you first thing tomorrow to chase down the contract. Hang in there, you're almost at the finish line!

messages.content: Hey, I just got out of a meeting with Boss Zhang about the Shenzhen trip. Good news on the budget front.
Oh nice! Did he ease up on that 20% cut he announced last month?
Yeah, exactly. Boss Zhang decided that the budget cut for the Shenzhen trip is revised from 20% down to 15%. I felt such a wave of relief knowing I won't have to stay in a cheap motel now.
That is a huge relief! A 15% cut gives you way more breathing room for a decent hotel. Did you two discuss anything else?

Just some travel details. Boss Zhang mentioned that it usually rains a lot during the Shenzhen trip this time of year, so I definitely need to pack an umbrella. We also discussed how the flight for the Shenzhen trip takes about 3 hours.
Got it. I'll add an umbrella to your packing list and maybe suggest downloading some offline work for that 3-hour flight. Want me to update the travel budget tracker?
Yes, please update the tracker with the new 15% cut limit. I need to get my hotel booked so I can focus on securing those two enterprise clients.
Done! The tracker is updated. Let me know when you're ready to look at hotel options.

golden_memories: On 2025-08-11, Boss Zhang decided that the budget cut for the Shenzhen trip is revised from 20% to 15%.

conversations.topic: Testing the new hardware compilation speed

messages.content: Hey! I was extremely excited to finally unbox the new MacBook this morning.
Nice! Nothing beats that new laptop feeling. How is it looking?
It's gorgeous. Wanghao came over to check it out and joked that the space gray color of the new MacBook looks very professional.
Space gray is definitely a classic. Did you guys get a chance to run any performance tests on it yet?
Yeah, we ran a quick benchmark. Wanghao concluded that the new MacBook compiles the main repository in exactly 45 seconds. It's a massive upgrade.
Whoa, 45 seconds for the main repo is blazing fast! That's going to save you so much time during your data analysis workflows.
For sure. Anyway, we agreed to grab coffee after finishing the setup of the new MacBook, so I'm heading out now.
Enjoy the coffee! Let me know if you need help installing any of your other tools when you get back.

golden_memories: On 2025-08-12, Wanghao concluded that the new MacBook compiles the main repository in exactly 45 seconds.

messages.content: Hey, just got out of the weekly sync. I need to jot down a few notes before I jump into my next task.
Sure thing, Linchen. How did the sync go?
Honestly, it went amazing. I felt a massive surge of confidence during the weekly sync because my data presentation was highly praised by the whole team!
That's awesome to hear! After all the stress with the OKR review lately, you definitely earned that win. What notes do you want to save?

Well, for my own reference, I presented exactly 15 slides during the weekly sync, which seemed to be the perfect length. Oh, and Sister Chen noted that the meeting room for the weekly sync was uncomfortably cold, so maybe we should avoid booking that specific room in the future.
Got it. 15 slides hits the sweet spot, and I'll keep the chilly room in mind for future bookings. Any other action items?
Just one admin thing. We decided to change the recurring calendar invite for the weekly sync to include a Zoom link from now on, since a few folks are working hybrid.
I'll remind you to update the calendar invite with that Zoom link. Great job crushing the presentation today!

golden_memories: On 2025-08-12, Linchen felt a massive surge of confidence during the weekly sync because his data presentation was highly praised.

conversations.topic: Calling Mom about the new place

messages.content: Hey, I just got off the phone with Mom about the apartment hunting. Honestly, I'm already feeling totally exhausted just thinking about moving boxes after we finally finish this whole process.
Moving is the worst, I don't blame you for feeling drained! How did the call with your mom go, though?

It went well! We discussed how the living room from the apartment hunting gets great afternoon sunlight. She was really happy about that. Though, of course, Mom asked if the rent price for the apartment hunting was over 6000 RMB.
Classic mom question! Afternoon sunlight is a massive win, though. Did you manage to reassure her about the budget?
Yeah, I told her we kept it reasonable. I actually promised Mom I would invite her over for a home-cooked dinner on the first weekend after finishing the apartment hunting.
That's a great idea to celebrate the new place! Want me to set a reminder for that dinner once you have the move-in date locked down?
Yes, please do. I want to make sure I don't forget to plan a nice menu for her.
Done! I'll keep it on my radar. For now, just take a breather—you're almost at the finish line with this apartment hunt.

golden_memories: On 2025-08-13, Linchen promised Mom he would invite her over for a home-cooked dinner on the first weekend after finishing the apartment hunting.

messages.content: Hey, I finally got the new MacBook today! The screen resolution on this thing is incredibly crisp, but honestly, I'm feeling totally overwhelmed by transferring all my old files to it.
Congrats on the upgrade! I know file transfers can be a massive headache. Want me to look up some migration tools to make it easier?
No need, Jiange was checking it out with me earlier. He mentioned that the new MacBook has 32GB of unified memory, so it should handle everything like a breeze once it's ready.
That 32GB of memory is going to be perfect for your data pipelines. Is Jiange going to give you a hand with the setup?
Yeah, exactly. Jiange scheduled to help me set up the development environment on the new MacBook at 8:00 PM on Thursday.
Awesome. I've noted down that Jiange is coming over at 8:00 PM tomorrow to help with the dev environment. Good luck with the rest of the file transfers!
Thanks! Hopefully we can get all the IDEs and databases configured quickly so I can test out the compilation speeds Wanghao was talking about.
With Jiange's help and that beast of a machine, you'll be flying through those compiles in no time. Let me know if you need anything else!

golden_memories: On 2025-08-13, Jiange scheduled to help Linchen set up the development environment on the new MacBook at 8:00 PM on Thursday.

Got it! I've noted that you'll be offline during your flight. Did you guys finalize the technical setup for the presentation?
Yeah, we did. Wanghao concluded that the local demo server for the Shenzhen trip must be able to handle exactly 500 concurrent connections to ensure it doesn't crash during the live walk-through.
Noted. 500 concurrent connections for the local demo server. I'll make sure that spec is logged. Anything else he brought up?
Mostly just joking around after that. Wanghao actually felt pretty envious that I get to eat authentic dim sum during the Shenzhen trip while he's stuck at the office.
Haha, I can't blame him! Authentic dim sum is definitely a huge perk. Are you going to bring anything back to ease his pain?
Yeah, I promised to bring back some local snacks from the Shenzhen trip for him and the rest of the team. Remind me to buy them before I head to the airport on my way back.
Will do! I'll set a reminder for you to pick up those local snacks before your return flight. Good luck with the 500-connection demo!

messages.content: Hey, can you update my notes on the weekly sync? Boss Zhang just announced a big change today.
Sure thing! What's the new plan for the weekly sync?
Boss Zhang decided that the format for the weekly sync will permanently shift to a written memo starting next week. So no more gathering in the big room.
Got it. I've noted the shift to a permanent written memo. Are there any specific guidelines for how you need to submit your updates now?

Yeah, the new memo template for the weekly sync requires exactly 3 bullet points per department. It's kind of funny, someone joked that the coffee during the weekly sync was the only reason people showed up anyway.
Haha, they're probably right about the coffee! Three bullet points sounds like it will keep things super focused. How are you feeling about the change?
To be honest, I felt an immense sense of relief knowing I wouldn't have to speak at the weekly sync anymore. Even though my presentation went great on Tuesday, I still get nervous.
That makes total sense. Now you can just let your data shine in those three bullet points without the public speaking stress. Enjoy the easier Fridays!

messages.content: Hey! Great news, the apartment hunting is officially over. We signed the lease today. I feel incredibly relieved and peaceful now that it's finally officially signed.
That is amazing news! Congratulations! I know how stressful the search has been, so you definitely deserve that peace of mind.
Thanks! It did take a big bite out of my savings, though. The security deposit for the apartment hunting was exactly two months' rent.
Ouch, two months' rent upfront is definitely a hefty chunk of change. But at least the place is officially yours now! Have you figured out how you're getting all your stuff over there?
Yeah, Sister Chen suggested we hire a moving company next Tuesday to finalize the apartment hunting. I think I'll take her advice so I don't break my back.
That's a very smart suggestion from Sister Chen. Let the pros handle the heavy lifting! Are you doing anything special to celebrate?
We actually talked about buying a new sofa to celebrate the end of the apartment hunting. A fresh start definitely calls for a comfy couch.
Absolutely! Couch-shopping sounds like the perfect way to celebrate. Enjoy the weekend and soak in that well-earned relief!

golden_memories: On 2025-08-16, Linchen felt incredibly relieved and peaceful about the apartment hunting because the lease was finally officially signed.
